networkMeasurement: Chromium CDP loadingFinished.encodedDataLength from actual loopback HTTP gzip responses; cached responses contribute observed encoded bytes. Synthetic SDK Auth/DB calls use browser bindings, so their logical calls are reported separately and their wire bytes are not measured.
cachePolicy: Controlled local HTTP: HTML no-store; static assets public,max-age=3600. No Playwright routing, cache not disabled. Each pair shares one browser context; localStorage (including Auth state) is cleared between cold/warm while HTTP cache and IndexedDB remain. Cold uses a fresh browser context; it does not mean a cold OS file cache. This is not an observed production cache policy.
limits: All timings are local synthetic measurements, not production latency.
Backend logical calls use fixed delay/browser bindings; backend wire bytes and real Supabase SDK download/parse cost are not measured.
Shared host CPU can vary; compare medians and ranges, not a guaranteed improvement.
Click-to-interactive starts after networkidle plus150ms; this isolates settled-page login rather than the earliest possible user click.
Initial requests/bytes are observed350ms after business readiness. Login-visible is a DOM layout/enabled predicate; FCP is recorded separately.
Cold means an empty browser context HTTP cache, not a cold operating-system file cache.
The same synthetic one-car account is used; real customer/account scale is not measured.
LogicalBackendBeforeFeatures covers navigation through350ms after business readiness; LogicalBackend scenario totals also include first feature use.
CDP encoded bytes are actual instrumented localhost responses, not predicted Internet transfer or production CDN bytes.
Warm revisits remove Auth localStorage; remembered-session auto-login latency is not measured.
backendWireBytesReason: Synthetic Auth/DB bindings do not have observed HTTP wire bytes.
